visualReview.notes: Inspected39 current portable/shared/medium-fi frames and13 combined site frames in the same author/build/inspect pass. Exact named theatre block/small rear-east courtyard, pale blue-green three-tier Neoclassical riverfront with ten engaged round giant-order columns, rusticated ground rectangles/separate arched transoms, piano window pediments, four simple original standing niche figures/four bust medallions, projecting cornices and a closed rounded upper canal-side roof corner. Separate rear military-headquarters block and Old Hermitage covered gallery are preserved, not duplicated. No furnished auditorium/historic rooms, copied fine sculpture/inscriptions or artificial courtyard floor. Native terrain fit remains rejected.
